details.description: Indulge in the delectable delight of Twix, a chocolate-covered caramel cookie bar that promises an unforgettable experience. Boasting a crunchy cookie base, smooth caramel, and creamy chocolate, each bite of Twix transports you to a world of chocolatey bliss. Savour the perfect balance of textures and flavours, with the crisp cookie providing a delightful contrast to the gooey caramel and rich chocolate. Whether you're enjoying a moment of personal indulgence or sharing the experience with loved ones, Twix adds a touch of chocolatey fun to life's little moments. Crafted with care, this irresistible treat is sure to create sweet memories and make your special occasions even more extraordinary. Indulge in the Twix experience and let the delectable combination of crunchy, smooth, and creamy delight your senses.
details.ingredients: Sugar, Glucose Syrup, Wheat Flour (17%), Palm Fat, Cocoa Butter, Skimmed Milk Powder, Cocoa Mass, Lactose, Milk Fat, Whey Powder, Fat Reduced Cocoa, Salt, Emulsifier (Soya Lecithin), Raising Agent (E500), Natural Vanilla Extract

details.description: Why This Chocolate? The Twix Chocolate Bar lets you indulge in chocolatey deliciousness with the crispness of a biscuit. Packed with crunchy cookies, smooth caramel, and creamy chocolate, Twix adds a touch of chocolatey fun to life's little moments. Each bite delivers gooey caramel and rich chocolate with just the right amount of crunch. What Makes It Unique? Every Twix pack contains two parallel bars and all you need to do is pick a side. The Left Twix is crisp, with a flavourful cookie and chewy caramel beneath a smooth, creamy chocolate layer, while the Right Twix is deliciously smooth, blending crunchy cookie, rich caramel, and delectable chocolate into one irresistible bite. Trust your taste buds and follow your instincts for an authentic Twix experience, whichever side you choose. When to Enjoy This Chocolate? Share this one-of-a-kind treat with friends, colleagues, or family, and make every moment memorable. Twix Chocolates also make the perfect gift for any occasion.
details.ingredients: Sugar, Liquid Glucose, Refined Wheat Flour (Maida) (17%), Edible Vegetable Fat (Palm Fat), Milk Solids, Cocoa Butter, Cocoa Solids, Salt, Emulsifier (322), Raising Agent (500(Ii)), Artificial Flavour (Ethyl Vanillin). Contains Milk, Soy, Wheat. May Contain Nuts, Barley, Oats. Contains Cocoa Butter Equivalent In Addition To Cocoa Butter
